- [Microphone](https://thenounproject.com/icon/microphone-171/) by [Edward Boatman](https://thenounproject.com/creator/edward/) from [Noun Project](https://thenounproject.com/browse/icons/term/microphone/) ([CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)).
- [Speaker](https://thenounproject.com/icon/speaker-100/) by [Edward Boatman](https://thenounproject.com/creator/edward/) from [Noun Project](https://thenounproject.com/browse/icons/term/speaker/) ([CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)).
- [Microphone](https://thenounproject.com/icon/microphone-856601/) by [i cons](https://thenounproject.com/creator/iconsguru/) from [Noun Project](https://thenounproject.com/browse/icons/term/microphone/) ([CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)).
- [Volume](https://thenounproject.com/icon/volume-974802/) by [i cons](https://thenounproject.com/creator/iconsguru/) from [Noun Project](https://thenounproject.com/browse/icons/term/volume/) ([CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)).

Modified for the AgentVoice design studio: the separate attribution footer was moved from the glyph canvas to these credits and accessible SVG descriptions; artwork was uniformly resized and positioned in a square canvas, with runtime color tinting. The i cons speaker received a slightly smaller uniform optical scale. Muted variants add a shared diagonal slash and transparent clearance. Original path shapes remain intact; SVG polygon and rounded-rectangle primitives were converted to equivalent Android path geometry.

Boatman's muted speaker also uses a transparent clip to remove disconnected lower wave fragments beneath the diagonal. Its upper waves, horn, source paths, and live form remain unchanged.

These icons remain licensed under CC BY 3.0, separately from the application code. No creator endorsement is implied. Original attribution text and exact source hashes are retained in normalization-receipt.json; the unmodified downloaded originals and acquisition evidence are retained separately by the integration owner.
